dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge displays a prominent concave curvature characteristic of a falcate profile, though the upper boundary is significantly modified by irregular notched tissue loss.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The morphological apex is jagged and irregular due to trauma; the underlying pixel geometry suggests a broad, rounded/obtuse apex before the onset of the notches.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: A smooth, low-gradient convex contour with an approximate 30 to 35-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin exhibits a wide base relative to its height, with an approximate 2.5:1 ratio of basal width to vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three distinct, deep V-shaped notches are visible on the upper trailing edge and apex; a horizontal indentation/crease is present at the anterior base of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Subtle epidermal mottling and linear surface scratches are visible on the lateral surface of the fin and the adjacent dorsal region.
